CHETAN DHAMANDE

📞 +91-7019270384 | ✉ cgdhamande03@gmail.com

🔗 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chetan-dhamande-654b0a19/

💼 SENIOR TRANSFORMATION CONSULTANT | PROCESS EXCELLENCE | BPM | SIGNAVIO | ARIS

Results-driven transformation leader with 9.5+ years of experience in driving enterprise-wide process transformation across BFSI and Telecom domains. Specialized in SAP Signavio, ARIS, BPMN 2.0, and Process Mining (Celonis – Working Knowledge) to deliver measurable business outcomes.

Proven track record of delivering 30–40% efficiency improvements, enabling data-driven decision-making, and leading cross-functional transformation programs across global teams.

CORE EXPERTISE

Business Process Transformation & Re-engineering

SAP Signavio & ARIS Process Modelling

BPMN 2.0 Governance & Standardization

Process Mining (Celonis) & Data Analytics

Stakeholder Management & CXO Collaboration

Gap Analysis (As-Is / To-Be)

Change Management & Adoption Strategy

Agile (Scrum) & SDLC Delivery

Operational Excellence & Continuous Improvement

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Advisor – Transformation | First Citizens India, Bangalore | Nov 2025 – Present Key Contributions:

Led enterprise-wide process transformation initiatives across Deposit Operations,

aligning processes with business and regulatory standards

Designed and implemented 50+ BPMN 2.0 process models using ARIS, improving process visibility and governance

Established data-driven process analysis frameworks, enabling proactive bottleneck identification and decision-making

Partnered with cross-functional stakeholders (5+ business units) to drive alignment and transformation execution

Spearheaded change management initiatives, ensuring high adoption across teams

Impact:

Improved process understanding time by 30%, accelerating decision-making

Increased process standardization and adoption by 40% across business units

Reduced process inefficiencies and errors by 20–25%

Enhanced bottleneck detection capability by 25% using data analytics



Associate Business Consultant | Tech Mahindra (Client: Telstra) Aug 2022 – Oct 2025

Key Contributions:

Delivered end-to-end process consulting for BFSI transformation programs

Created BPMN models using SAP Signavio & ARIS to improve operational workflows

Facilitated stakeholder workshops, requirement gathering, and alignment sessions

Performed process gap analysis and optimization initiatives across multiple functions

Supported process standardization and governance frameworks

Impact:

Improved operational efficiency through structured process redesign

Reduced rework by enhancing process documentation quality

Enabled faster decision-making through improved process visibility

Process Engineering Administrator | Wells Fargo, Bangalore Nov 2020 – Aug 2022

Supported process engineering and documentation initiatives

Contributed to process standardization and operational improvements

Risk Advisor Deloitte, Bangalore | Feb 2020 – Oct 2020

Delivered risk and process consulting engagements for BFSI clients

Conducted process assessments, control evaluations, and compliance reviews

Identified improvement opportunities and recommended process optimization strategies

Business Analyst |

Himalayan Megalith Pvt Ltd | 2019 – 2020

Muddy Roads Technologies Pvt Ltd | 2016 – 2019

Gathered and analysed business requirements

Supported process improvement and implementation initiatives

EDUCATION

MBA (Marketing & Operations) – Nagpur University (2019)

BE (Computer Engineering) – Nagpur University (2016)

TECHNICAL SKILLS

SAP Signavio, ARIS

Celonis (Process Mining)

SQL, Power BI, Tableau

Advanced Excel (Data Analysis)

BPMN 2.0 Modelling

Agile (Scrum), JIRA

CERTIFICATIONS

Lean Six Sigma Black Belt

Scrum Master Certification

Process Mining with Celonis

BPM & Value Stream Mapping (VSM)

Prompt Engineering (AI Tools)
